exposure: Physical activity programme based on the Pilates method
cohort: The study included a total of 105 pregnant women, with an intervention group of 50 women (mean age 32.87 years) and a control group of 55 women (mean age 31.52 years).
finding: An 8-week physical activity program based on the Pilates method significantly improved functional parameters like blood pressure, strength, flexibility, and spinal curvature in pregnant women, and reduced Caesareans, obstructed labour, episiotomies, analgesia, and newborn weight.
mod_finding: The Pilates-based physical activity programme decreased the number of Caesareans, obstructed labour, episiotomies, and analgesia during delivery.
